title: Explicit Nonlinear Functions beyond the Fourier bound
summary: We study the problem of constructing highly nonlinear vectorial maps $F: \mathbb F_2^n \to \mathbb F_2^m$. Concretely, we want an $F$ and an $A = A(m,n)> 0$ as small as possible, so that for every affine map $L: \mathbb F_2^n \to \mathbb F_2^m$ (of the form $L(x) = M x + b $) we have: $$\mathrm{agree}(F, L) := |\{ x \in \mathbb F_2^n \mid F(x) = L(x) \}| \leq A.$$ Such questions have been studied by Nyberg (1991,1993), Carlet and Ding (2004,2007), Liu, Mesnager and Chen (2017), Nagy (2025), and Biryukov, Turecek, and Udovenko (2026).
